label: Product Tabs
purpose: Tabbed content sections for product information (description, shipping, materials, etc.)
_notes:
IMPORTANT: this block does NOT use child blocks — it has exactly 3 FIXED tab slots (tab_1/tab_2/tab_3) built into its own settings, each with its own title/icon/content. There is no way to add a 4th tab, and there is no separate 'tab' block type to nest inside it (a previous catalog version incorrectly modeled this with child blocks named 'tab_content' — that does not exist in the real schema). tab_N_content is richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags. tab_N_icon is a Material Symbols icon name; tab_N_custom_icon overrides it with an image. Each tab also has a tab_N_page (Shopify page reference) setting that can substitute a full page's content for tab_N_content — omitted here since there is no real page handle to reference. Excluded as pure visual: visibility, tab_text_size(_mobile), tab_text_icon_scale, button_alignment, divider_thickness, active_indicator_thickness, content_size, tab_text_color, active_tab_color, divider_color, active_indicator_color, content_text_color, margins.
